title: DialFact: A Benchmark for Fact-Checking in Dialogue

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Local Mutual Information (LMI) to calculate the correlation between specific bigrams in the claims and their fact-checking categories (Supported, Refuted, NEI). The authors also train a 'claim-only' baseline model with no evidence to test whether models can exploit these lexical artifacts or cues to achieve good performance without performing actual verification.
